fields.description: Core settings for one ERPNext company and its BMD target.
fields.label: General

fields.description: ERPNext company for which this BMD export configuration applies.
fields.label: Company

fields.description: Only enabled settings are available to the export workflow.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Optional company identifier expected by the target BMD tenant.
fields.label: BMD Company Number

fields.description: Controls the exported columns, encoding and number formats.
fields.label: Export Profile

fields.description: Plain filename used for the booking CSV inside the export package.
fields.label: CSV Filename

fields.description: Controls how ERPNext invoices are represented in BMD booking rows.
fields.label: Invoice Rules

fields.description: Writes the invoice posting date to the BMD booking-date field.
fields.label: Include Booking Date

fields.description: Selects whether the ERPNext document name or supplier invoice number becomes the BMD voucher number.
fields.label: Purchase Invoice BMD Voucher Number

fields.description: Exports cost allocations as separate BMD Satzart 1 rows instead of fields on the booking row.
fields.label: Use Satzart 1 KORE Allocations

fields.description: BMD foreign-currency variant 1 leaves the exchange rate empty. Enable only if the target import requires fwkurs.
fields.label: Include Foreign Exchange Rate

fields.description: Fallback BMD cost center when no dimension mapping supplies a cost center.
fields.label: Default BMD Cost Center

fields.description: Fallback BMD branch used when the selected tax mapping has no branch.
fields.label: Default BMD Branch

fields.description: Defines which invoice documents are required and may be included in the transport package.
fields.label: Documents

fields.description: Blocks the export of a Sales Invoice when no permitted document is available.
fields.label: Require Sales Invoice Attachment

fields.description: Blocks the export of a Purchase Invoice when no permitted document is available.
fields.label: Require Purchase Invoice Attachment

fields.description: Comma-separated file extensions accepted for exported attachments, without dots.
fields.label: Allowed Extensions

fields.description: Comma-separated MIME types accepted after content validation.
fields.label: Allowed MIME Types

fields.description: Maximum permitted size of one exported attachment.
fields.label: Maximum File Size (MB)

fields.description: Creates a PDF from the Sales Invoice print view when no attachment exists.
fields.label: Generate Sales Invoice PDF if Missing

fields.description: Print Format used to create the fallback Sales Invoice PDF.
fields.label: Sales Invoice Print Format

fields.description: Jinja template for the exported filename stem. The verified original extension is appended automatically. Applied to every new exported attachment; the original ERPNext filename remains unchanged.
fields.label: Document Filename Template

fields.description: Safety limits for export size and storage duration.
fields.label: Limits and Retention

fields.description: Maximum number of BMD booking rows allowed in one export batch.
fields.label: Maximum Satzart 0 Rows

fields.description: Number of days generated CSV and ZIP artifacts are retained before cleanup.
fields.label: Artifact Retention (Days)
